subject: Palo Alto’s $4.5B AI deal 💰, OVHcloud unveils 55 products ☁️, Google’s AI reviews Linux 🐧

stories.headline: Palo Alto Networks agrees to acquire Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in stock
stories.quote: Palo Alto Networks agreed to acquire Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in stock, adding tools for training and serving customized open-weight AI models.
stories.description: Tools for training and serving customized open-weight AI models

facts.text: Deal expected to close in Palo Alto Networks' fiscal third quarter of 2027; will support deployments across public and sovereign clouds.
facts.quote: The deal is expected to close in its fiscal third quarter of 2027 and will support deployments across public and sovereign clouds.

stories.headline: Microsoft and Intel expand long-term collaboration on Azure cloud and AI infrastructure
stories.quote: Microsoft and Intel have announced an expansion of their collaboration under a long-term agreement to advance Azure cloud and AI infrastructure.

facts.text: Microsoft will be first to use Intel Foundry's EMIB advanced packaging for its first-party silicon and secures multi-year Intel Xeon supply, including Diamond Rapids.
facts.quote: Microsoft will become the first company to use Intel Foundry's EMIB advanced packaging technology for its first-party silicon and secure multi-year Intel Xeon supply capacity, including the upcoming Diamond Rapids server CPUs.

stories.headline: Workday plans Ireland-based company with EU-citizen board to operate its EU Sovereign Cloud
stories.quote: Workday plans to establish an Ireland-based company with an EU-citizen board to operate its EU Sovereign Cloud, keeping governance and operational decisions in Europe.

facts.text: Service runs on AWS European Sovereign Cloud; new entity and safeguards expected operational in early 2027.
facts.quote: The service runs on AWS European Sovereign Cloud, with the new entity and additional safeguards expected to become operational in early 2027.

stories.headline: Nvidia and Microsoft expand Azure VMs powered by Vera Rubin systems and on-premises AI options
stories.quote: Nvidia and Microsoft are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by Vera Rubin systems and adding more model customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry.

facts.text: Planned Azure Local support for additional Nvidia GPUs and Jetson platforms.
facts.quote: Planned Azure Local support for additional Nvidia GPUs and Jetson platforms will extend deployment options to on-premises and industrial environments.

stories.headline: OVHcloud unveils 55 cloud and AI offerings at its Paris summit
stories.quote: OVHcloud unveiled 55 cloud and AI offerings spanning infrastructure, networking, development tools, and enterprise applications at its Paris summit.

facts.text: Plans to add Nvidia Blackwell B300 and Rubin R200 GPUs.
facts.quote: The announcements include plans to add Nvidia Blackwell B300 and Rubin R200 GPUs as the company expands its European-hosted services.

stories.headline: Microsoft introduces agent controls, a managed Azure service for governing AI agent behavior
stories.quote: Microsoft has introduced agent controls, a managed Azure service designed to help enterprises centrally define, manage, and evaluate policies governing AI agent behavior.
